subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

MOROSE
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**Morose**' means bad-tempered, and not saying much to other people.(उदास)

 
 
• **Example **- The rainy weather made her feel **morose **and depressed.
 
 
 
• '**Jovial**' means cheerful, happy, or full of good humor.(उल्लासपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example **- The **jovial **host made everyone feel welcome at the party.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of '**Morose**' is '**Jovial**'.

Therefore, the** correct answer** is '**Jovial**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences.

 
• **Hurried **(जल्दी में हुआ) - Done (too) quickly; moving rapidly or performed quickly.

 
 
• **Example **- They are inclined to work at their own pace and will not be **hurried**.
 
 
 
• **Dramatic **(नाटकीय) - Noticeable or sudden and often surprising.
 
 
• **Example **- There has been a **dramatic **change in his attitude.
 
 
 
• **Practical **(व्यावहारिक) - Concerned with actually doing something rather than with ideas or thought.
 
 
• **Example **- We need a **practical **scheme that will not be too expensive.
